definitions.explanation: Returning something to its original or normal working state after damage, failure, or disruption. Commonly used for infrastructure, systems, and services.

examples.japanese: {停電|ていでん}から{復旧|ふっきゅう}するまで{三時間|さんじかん}かかった。
examples.english: It took three hours to recover from the power outage.

examples.japanese: システムの{復旧|ふっきゅう}{作業|さぎょう}が{進|すす}んでいる。
{道路|どうろ}の{復旧|ふっきゅう}には{時間|じかん}がかかる{見込|みこ}みだ。
examples.english: Road repairs are expected to take time.

notes:
WORD STRUCTURE:
{復|ふく} (return, restore) + {旧|きゅう} (old, former)
Literally "return to former state."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{復旧|ふっきゅう}{作業|さぎょう} - recovery work
・{復旧|ふっきゅう}{工事|こうじ} - restoration construction
・{復旧|ふっきゅう}の{見込|みこ}み - prospects for recovery
・{完全|かんぜん}{復旧|ふっきゅう} - full recovery

IT CONTEXT:
・システム{復旧|ふっきゅう} - system recovery
・データ{復旧|ふっきゅう} - data recovery
・{障害|しょうがい}{復旧|ふっきゅう} - fault recovery
・{復旧|ふっきゅう}ポイント - restore point

DISASTER CONTEXT:
・{災害|さいがい}{復旧|ふっきゅう} - disaster recovery
・ライフライン{復旧|ふっきゅう} - lifeline restoration

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{復興|ふっこう} - reconstruction (broader, includes development)
・{修復|しゅうふく} - repair, restoration (often physical objects)
・{回復|かいふく} - recovery (health, economy)
